title: AO-MA ADR Front-matter
description: Schema for the YAML front-matter block of an Architecture Decision Record (Markdown body). The body itself is free-form prose so human decision rationale stays human-readable; only the machine-readable front-matter is validated. AO-MA-11G-1 introduces this contract under the SPM Quality Profile Hardening slice (CNS-20260601-002 Codex thread 019e8050 AGREE). No support widening, no production platform claim, no live adapter execution, no GitHub write authority — ADRs are evidence records that document decisions; release authority remains with the ao-release-gate required check + branch ruleset + non-author approval.

id.description: ADR identifier. The Markdown filename MUST match this id: ADR-NNNN-<slug>.md.

date.description: ISO 8601 calendar date YYYY-MM-DD. The parse layer normalizes YAML implicit-timestamp coercion to this string form.

supersedes.description: IDs of ADRs this one supersedes. Canonical supersession edge.

superseded_by.description: Reciprocal metadata: when this ADR's status is 'superseded', the newer ADR's id.

slice_ref.description: Optional AO-MA slice / PR / consultation reference that this decision binds to (e.g. AO-MA-4.6-1 #766, CNS-20260601-001).

retrospective.description: True if this ADR back-populates a decision that was already taken (before the ADR discipline existed). Retrospective ADRs MUST also carry review_status and back_populated_at.

review_status.description: Provenance of the decision record. 'original' = born in an ADR; 'back_populated_pending_cross_ai_revalidation' = retro, awaits a separate cross-AI consensus pass; 'cross_ai_validated' = retro and re-confirmed by another provider.

back_populated_at.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp of the back-population (when the retro ADR was written, not when the underlying decision was taken).
